steps.en: A reduction is recorded as a temporary suspension
The reduction end date is kept and combined with other suspensions
steps.id: Tanggal berakhir reduction disimpan dan digabung dengan suspension lain

steps.en: Reminder letters skip notices under suspension or reduction
steps.id: Surat reminder melewati notice yang sedang suspension atau reduction
steps.why_en: Letters are only generated by a manual trigger; the daily schedule does not run them.
steps.why_id: Surat hanya dibuat lewat pemicu manual; jadwal harian tidak menjalankannya.

steps.en: Reminders check for a reduction only indirectly
steps.id: Pengingat memeriksa reduction hanya secara tidak langsung
steps.why_en: No dedicated reduction check exists; it only works because the reduction is stored as a suspension.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pemeriksaan reduction tersendiri; hanya berfungsi karena reduction disimpan sebagai suspension.

steps.en: Overlapping periods hold the notice until the longest one ends
steps.id: Periode yang tumpang tindih menahan notice sampai yang terpanjang berakhir

steps.en: Other automatic jobs still move or notify notices under reduction
steps.id: Job otomatis lain masih memajukan atau memberi tahu notice yang sedang reduction
steps.why_en: One job still advances the notice stage and the text/email channel is off in production.
steps.why_id: Satu job masih memajukan stage notice dan saluran SMS/email dimatikan di produksi.
